dateBasis: The UTC and Asia/Jerusalem values represent the same instant.
intent: Behavior-preserving separation of the mandatory company-scoped database loader from pure task-coordination view projection.

contractPrerequisite.scopeBoundary: This issue does not adopt task-coordination.v2 or change #53 evidence semantics.

designDecision.publicFacade: getIssueCoordination(db, rootIssueId, companyId) remains the production detail entry point.
designDecision.privateLoader: loadIssueCoordinationSnapshot and its helper queries remain module-private and require companyId.
designDecision.pureProjector: projectTaskCoordinationView performs no database access, authorization, or filtering and receives an explicit observedAt clock.
designDecision.securityInvariant: Root, child, participation, lease, control-intent, agent-instance, host, and company-list reads retain their company predicate. A root moved after scope authorization returns null.
designDecision.deferred: Repeatable-read snapshot isolation, v2 truthfulness semantics, list-query optimization, and write controls remain outside #82.

negativeProof.break: Removed only eq(issues.companyId, companyId) from the child-issue query after asserting the safe predicate was present.

observedFailure.reason: Both the direct-service and real HTTP assertions received the deliberately crossed-company child ID. The foreign-root denial and root-reassignment controls still passed.

warnings: Existing process-tree teardown sites have not yet adopted one canonical primitive.
Existing temporary-directory sites have not yet adopted the shared ephemeral-scratch helper.

staticReview.reviewScope: Behavior equivalence, TypeScript structural compatibility, mandatory company predicates, fail-closed root reassignment, and maintainability.

maintainability.duplicationDecision: The two status maps remain separate because blocked, cancelled, and closed have different task and work-unit meanings.
maintainability.testException: The 92-line makeSnapshot fixture and full expected-view block are declarative test data with no control complexity; independent static review accepted keeping each cohesive.

rawEvidence.retention: Raw transcripts remain operator-local under the checkout's Git metadata and are intentionally not referenced by machine-local path in this public receipt.
